# Matic Issue Workflow
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Next action: list open issues labeled `matic`, score eligible candidates, and start the lowest-scoring simplest issue.

## Purpose

Handle one GitHub issue at a time through the existing Lead Hub build pipeline, with PM Control preparation before implementation, reconciliation before quality measurement, a reviewed PR to `staging`, and explicit issue closure after merge.

## Trigger

Run this workflow when the user asks to:

- run the next issue labeled `matic`;
- resume a recorded matic run;
- check a matic PR or review feedback;
- close the related issue after a matic PR merges.

Do not run it when the request is a normal application build request, a production deployment request, or an issue without the `matic` label.

## Interface Contract

```text
GitHub issue and PR state + project context + existing build stages -> select, execute, verify, publish, and close one authorized issue -> run evidence, PM Control updates, PR, and issue state
```

| Interface | Declaration |
|---|---|
| Inputs | Open GitHub issues labeled `matic`, current PR and review state, repository source, project controls, approved scope, and existing stage outputs |
| Transform | Orchestrate one issue through selection, plan-control, Define, Design, Build, Reconcile, Measure, Learn, Publish, and post-merge closure |
| Outputs | Inspectable run evidence, relevant PM Control updates, one reviewed PR targeting `staging`, and issue closure only after verified merge |

## Routing

| Request | Route | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Run next matic issue | `stages/01-select/CONTEXT.md` | Ranked candidates and one selected issue run |
| Resume an active matic run | Recorded `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md` | Continue from the recorded stage |
| Prepare issue plan and controls | `stages/02-plan-control/CONTEXT.md` | Execution plan, acceptance matrix, and pre-build PM Control updates |
| Define the selected issue | `../../stages/01-define/CONTEXT.md` | Existing cycle definition and handoff |
| Design the selected issue | `../../stages/02-design/CONTEXT.md` | Existing environment gate and solution design |
| Execute the selected issue | `../../stages/03-build/CONTEXT.md` | Existing source change and build handoff |
| Reconcile completed issue work | `stages/04-reconcile/CONTEXT.md` | Affected carriers and PM Control reconciled |
| Measure the completed issue | `../../stages/04-measure/CONTEXT.md` | Quality score, acceptance results, and gate decision |
| Decide what happens next | `../../stages/05-learn/CONTEXT.md` | Verified `what-now.md` and publication route |
| Publish a passed issue | `stages/05-publish/CONTEXT.md` | Commit, push, PR to `staging`, and review request |
| Check merge or close issue | `stages/06-close-merged/CONTEXT.md` | Merge verification or explicit issue closure |

## Matic Sequence

```text
01-select -> 02-plan-control -> 01-define -> 02-design -> 03-build -> 04-reconcile
-> 04-measure -> 05-learn -> 05-publish -> 06-close-merged
```

The numbered stages from `workspace/stages/` are the existing build pipeline. The numbered stages under this directory are orchestration stages. `06-close-merged` is independently invoked after publication when GitHub reports a merge or review event.

## Input Gate

- The repository is `adventistasia/lead-lab`.
- A candidate is open and has the exact `matic` label.
- No active run or open PR already owns the candidate unless this is a resume or status request.
- The issue has a clear outcome and acceptance condition.
- The worktree is clean before a new branch is created.
- The required project, environment, authority, and review inputs are available.

If any gate fails, do not guess. Use the recorded run state when a run exists; otherwise report that no run was started.

## State And Recovery

- Store matic run artifacts in `application/runs/<date>-matic-issue-<number>-<slug>/`.
- Store the durable state in `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md`.
- Use `Blocked` for missing information, access, authority, or human decisions.
- Use `Awaiting review` or `Awaiting merge` for an external PR boundary.
- Use `Paused` only when the user asks to stop.
- Resume from the recorded stage. Do not rebuild unaffected stages.

## Completion

The matic workflow is complete only when:

- the selected issue's implementation is reconciled;
- Measure passed and Learn was written;
- the exact intended files were committed and pushed;
- the PR targets `staging` and requests `dennisatssd`;
- the exact PR is verified merged into `staging`; and
- the related GitHub issue is closed with a traceable comment.
